briefs.rationale: The two gained pages extend the part's arc rather than sitting in it by association: Fatou limits, Blaschke products and inner-outer factorisation give the analytic Hardy spaces and the Smirnov-Nevanlinna boundary theory their canonical form, and the level-one modular-forms page carries the argument principle and valence formula through Eisenstein series and the discriminant to the j-invariant classification of complex tori. The rewrite states both inside the existing contour-Cauchy-to-$\bar\partial$ narrative, condensing the remaining page names into their thematic roles so the brief stays within its 120-word limit.
